description: This file defines the MerchantUtils utility class, which provides methods related to merchant store information, specifically for generating footer messages.

classes.name: MerchantUtils
classes.description: Utility class for merchant-related helper methods.

methods.name: getFooterMessage
methods.description: Generates a footer message for a merchant store using optional prefix and suffix.
parameters: MerchantStore store: The merchant store object containing store info.
String prefix: An optional prefix for the message.
String suffix: An optional suffix for the message.
